cases.question: What are the latest interest rate decisions in the demonstration economy?
cases.objective: Recency question with two dated fixtures.
cases.expected_behavior: The report states the decision date and warns that offline fixture content is not live data.

interest rate.title: Example fixture: rate decision announcement
interest rate.snippet: Fixture announcement with a placeholder policy rate change for the demonstration economy.

interest rate.title: Example fixture: rate press conference summary
interest rate.snippet: Fixture summary of placeholder guidance given after the demonstration rate decision.

cases.notes: Same day fixtures exercise multi source corroboration labeling.

cases.question: Which election results were certified most recently in the demonstration district?
cases.objective: Certification status question with two fixtures.
cases.expected_behavior: Claims distinguish announced results from certified results and cite each.

election.title: Example fixture: election night tally
election.snippet: Fixture tally with placeholder vote shares for the demonstration district race.

election.title: Example fixture: certification notice
election.snippet: Fixture notice describing placeholder certification steps for the demonstration district results.

cases.notes: Fixture dates describe a demonstration calendar.

cases.question: What is the current status of the demonstration wildfire containment?
cases.objective: Fast changing situation with a stale and a fresh fixture.
cases.expected_behavior: The report prefers the fresh update for current status, keeps the stale one dated, and says the picture may have changed since retrieval.

wildfire.title: Example fixture: wildfire morning update
wildfire.snippet: Fixture update with placeholder containment percentages for the demonstration fire.

wildfire.title: Example fixture: wildfire stale report
wildfire.snippet: Fixture report with placeholder containment percentages from the start of the demonstration incident.

cases.notes: Staleness must be visible, not hidden.

cases.question: Which vaccine recommendations changed in the demonstration immunization schedule this year?
cases.objective: Guidance change question with two fixtures.
cases.expected_behavior: Changes are stated as differences between dated sources and the report lists the change dates.

vaccine.title: Example fixture: immunization schedule revision
vaccine.snippet: Fixture revision note listing placeholder schedule changes adopted by the demonstration committee.

vaccine.title: Example fixture: immunization practice note
vaccine.snippet: Fixture practice note describing how placeholder schedule changes are applied in demonstration clinics.

cases.notes: Health adjacent content stays clearly fixture labeled.

cases.question: What are the most recent refugee resettlement numbers for the demonstration program?
cases.objective: Latest figures question with two dated fixtures.
cases.expected_behavior: The newer figure is used for the current claim and the older one stays as history with its date.

refugee.title: Example fixture: resettlement quarterly figures
refugee.snippet: Fixture quarterly release with placeholder resettlement arrivals for the demonstration program.

refugee.title: Example fixture: resettlement annual review
refugee.snippet: Fixture annual review with placeholder yearly resettlement totals for the demonstration program.

cases.notes: Quarterly and annual periods must stay separated.

cases.question: Which demonstrations and counterprotests are scheduled in the capital this week?
cases.objective: Schedule question without fixtures to test honest insufficiency.
cases.expected_behavior: The report says the evidence base is inadequate for a schedule and suggests follow up queries instead of inventing events.

cases.question: What did the demonstration weather service say about the incoming storm?
cases.objective: Single advisory fixture with a near current date.
cases.expected_behavior: The advisory is quoted with its issue time and the report warns that forecasts change.

storm.title: Example fixture: storm advisory bulletin
storm.snippet: Fixture bulletin with placeholder wind and rainfall guidance for the demonstration storm.

cases.notes: Advisory content is fictional and labeled.
